accepted.s:
The Van (Sanrakshan evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam, which replaced the earlier name of the Forest Conservation law, applies to which of the following categories of land?
1. Notified forests
2. Land recorded as forest on or after 25 October 1980
3. All private agricultural land adjoining a forest
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The renamed Act applies to notified forests and land recorded as forest on or after 25 October 1980. It does not automatically cover all adjoining private agricultural land.
accepted.tq: Separate the precise statutory coverage from the extreme claim that all adjoining land is included.
accepted.sec: Forest Conservation Amendment Act 2023 - effect on tribal rights

accepted.s: Under the Forest Conservation Amendment Act, 2023, central approval is not required for certain strategic projects located within what distance of an international border?
accepted.x: The amendment provides an exemption from central approval for strategic projects within 100 km of international borders, among other specified exemptions.
accepted.tq: Use the distance figure as the decisive numerical clue.
accepted.sec: Forest Conservation Amendment Act 2023 - effect on tribal rights

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the exemptions associated with the Forest Conservation Amendment Act, 2023?
o: Strategic projects within 100 km of international borders
Mandatory Gram Sabha consent for every new exemption
accepted.x: The amendment is criticised because it is silent on the Forest Rights Act and does not mandate Gram Sabha consent for the new exemptions. Strategic projects, eco-tourism and zoos are among the mentioned exemptions.
accepted.tq: Find the option that reverses the criticism about the absence of Gram Sabha consent.
accepted.sec: Forest Conservation Amendment Act 2023 - effect on tribal rights

accepted.s: The Forest Conservation Rules, 2022, became the subject of a dispute between which two bodies regarding the consent clause?
accepted.x: The Forest Conservation Rules, 2022, which dropped the consent clause, led to a dispute between the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes and the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
accepted.tq: Match the issue with the two authorities directly associated with it.
accepted.sec: Forest Conservation Amendment Act 2023 - effect on tribal rights

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Stand-Up India:
1. It was launched on 5 April 2016.
2. It is administered by the Ministry of Finance.
3. Every bank branch is intended to lend to at least one SC or ST borrower and one woman borrower.
4. It is meant exclusively for existing enterprises.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Stand-Up India was launched on 5 April 2016 under the Ministry of Finance and targets at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for a greenfield enterprise. It is not exclusively for existing enterprises.
accepted.tq: Reject the swapped purpose in statement 4 and retain the date, ministry and beneficiary conditions.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: The loan range under Stand-Up India is:
accepted.x: Stand-Up India provides loans ranging from Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact lower and upper limits from nearby financing ranges.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the financial terms associated with Stand-Up India loans?
o: Up to 50% of project cost, repayable in five years, with NABARD refinance
Up to 90% of project cost, repayable over fifteen years, with NSFDC refinance
Up to 75% of project cost, repayable in ten years, with RBI refinance
Up to 85% of project cost, repayable over seven years, with SIDBI refinance
accepted.x: Stand-Up India loans may cover up to 85% of project cost, can be repaid over seven years and are supported by SIDBI refinance.
accepted.tq: Compare the three linked financial conditions rather than relying on the loan amount alone.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: The Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes is associated with which of the following combinations?
o: Ministry of Finance; 2016-17; Rs 1 lakh to Rs 10 lakh
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; 2014-15; Rs 10 lakh to Rs 15 crore
Ministry of Tribal Affairs; 2001-02; Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore
Ministry of Rural Development; 2013-14; Rs 15 lakh to Rs 25 crore
accepted.x: The Venture Capital Fund for SCs is under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, dates from 2014-15 and has a range of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 15 crore.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure ministry-year pair and verify the investment range.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: NSFDC — Set up in 1989 for SCs with family income up to Rs 3 lakh
NSTFDC — Set up in 1989 under the Ministry of Finance
NSFDC — Set up in 2001 by splitting the joint SC/ST corporation
NSTFDC — A corporation exclusively for Scheduled Castes
accepted.x: NSFDC was set up in 1989 for Scheduled Castes whose family income is up to Rs 3 lakh. NSTFDC was set up in 2001 for Scheduled Tribes by splitting the joint SC/ST corporation.
accepted.tq: Use the body’s target group and founding year to eliminate swapped identities.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: Under the NSTFDC scheme for forest dwellers holding titles under the Forest Rights Act, assistance is provided at:
accepted.x: The NSTFDC forest-dweller scheme provides 90% of the cost at 6% interest to Forest Rights Act title-holders.
accepted.tq: Pair the percentage with the interest rate instead of treating either figure in isolation.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: As of March 2025, Stand-Up India had sanctioned or facilitated loans of approximately:
accepted.x: By March 2025, Stand-Up India had recorded 2.75 lakh loans worth Rs 62,790 crore.
accepted.tq: Read the paired count-and-value figure as one combined data point.
accepted.sec: Economic empowerment - Stand-Up India, Venture Capital Fund for SCs, NSFDC and NSTFDC loans

accepted.s: The Dr Ambedkar Foundation is chaired by the:
o: Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: The Dr Ambedkar Foundation is chaired by the Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who would do this job?’ method to identify the responsible ministry.
accepted.sec: Dr Ambedkar Foundation initiatives - Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence, coaching schemes

accepted.s: Which of the following institutions is associated with the Dr Ambedkar Foundation?
accepted.x: The Dr Ambedkar Foundation runs the Dr Ambedkar National Centre located at Janpath, besides its other schemes.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the named institution and location from similarly worded welfare institutions.
accepted.sec: Dr Ambedkar Foundation initiatives - Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence, coaching schemes

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence:
1. They provide free Civil Services coaching.
2. Their beneficiaries are SC students.
3. They function in Central Universities.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence provide free Civil Services coaching to SC students in Central Universities.
accepted.tq: Test the beneficiary, purpose and institutional setting together.
accepted.sec: Dr Ambedkar Foundation initiatives - Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence, coaching schemes

accepted.s: SHRESHTA is intended to place bright SC students in top residential schools through a test conducted by:
o: UPSC under the Civil Services Examination
accepted.x: SHRESHTA places bright SC students in top residential schools through the National Testing Agency’s NETS test.
accepted.tq: Separate the exact testing agency and test name from similar national examinations.
accepted.sec: Dr Ambedkar Foundation initiatives - Dr Ambedkar Centres of Excellence, coaching schemes

accepted.s: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation of Andhra Pradesh was established in:
accepted.x: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation was set up in 1956.
accepted.tq: Use the founding-year distinction among welfare corporations.
accepted.sec: AP SC/ST welfare corporations and schemes - founding year and role, land purchase, self-employment

accepted.s:
Which of the following functions is associated with the Girijan Cooperative Corporation?
1. Purchasing minor forest produce at fair prices
2. Running PDS depots
3. Providing credit to tribal farmers
4. Conducting the NTA’s NETS examination
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The GCC purchases minor forest produce at fair prices, runs PDS depots and gives credit to tribal farmers. Conducting the NETS examination is associated with the NTA, not the GCC.
accepted.tq: Identify the one function belonging to another institution and retain the three GCC roles.
accepted.sec: AP SC/ST welfare corporations and schemes - founding year and role, land purchase, self-employment

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly associated with the Andhra Pradesh SC Co-operative Finance Corporation?
o: Implementation of the National Overseas Scholarship
Self-employment support including rehabilitation of Jogin women
Profiling sanitation workers in urban local bodies
Marketing of minor forest produce at minimum support price
accepted.x: The APSCCFC provides self-employment support, including rehabilitation of Jogin women under the Andhra Pradesh Devadasis Act, 1989.
accepted.tq: Match the corporation with its distinctive rehabilitation function.
accepted.sec: AP SC/ST welfare corporations and schemes - founding year and role, land purchase, self-employment

accepted.s:
Which of the following welfare measures is specifically mentioned for SC beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh?
1. A pension of Rs 4,000 for Dappu artists and cobblers
2. Free power up to 200 units for SC households
3. Free Civil Services coaching for all students irrespective of category
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: SC pensions of Rs 4,000 are provided to Dappu artists and cobblers, and SC households receive free power up to 200 units. The coaching provision is not stated as category-neutral.
accepted.tq: Reject the overbroad ‘irrespective of category’ claim while retaining the two specific AP measures.
accepted.sec: AP SC/ST welfare corporations and schemes - founding year and role, land purchase, self-employment

accepted.s: The NAMASTE scheme is primarily aimed at:
o: Providing overseas scholarships to sanitation workers
Replacing all municipal workers with automated machines
Ending manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks
accepted.x: NAMASTE, launched in 2022, seeks to end manual cleaning of sewers and septic tanks and promote mechanised sanitation.
accepted.tq: Identify the scheme’s central objective from the practical situation described.
accepted.sec: Sanitation workers' welfare - NAMASTE scheme for sewers and septic tanks

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes the institutional framework of NAMASTE?
1. It is jointly associated with MoSJE and MoHUA.
2. It is implemented by NSKFDC.
3. Its financial allocation is Rs 349.70 crore.
4. It is implemented by TRIFED.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: NAMASTE involves the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, is implemented by NSKFDC and has an allocation of Rs 349.70 crore. TRIFED is not its implementing agency.
accepted.tq: Catch the wrong-body trap by distinguishing sanitation and tribal marketing agencies.
accepted.sec: Sanitation workers' welfare - NAMASTE scheme for sewers and septic tanks

accepted.s: Under NAMASTE, the capital subsidy may extend up to:
accepted.x: NAMASTE provides a capital subsidy of up to Rs 7.5 lakh.
accepted.tq: Use the exact subsidy ceiling as the tested numerical fact.
accepted.sec: Sanitation workers' welfare - NAMASTE scheme for sewers and septic tanks

accepted.s:
Consider the following components of NAMASTE:
1. Profiling of workers in more than 4,800 ULBs
2. PPE and safety training
3. A 25% subsidy on machines
4. Skilling with a stipend of Rs 3,000
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four are components of NAMASTE: worker profiling in over 4,800 ULBs, PPE and safety training, a 25% machine subsidy and skilling with a Rs 3,000 stipend.
accepted.tq: Check each component independently before selecting the inclusive combination.
accepted.sec: Sanitation workers' welfare - NAMASTE scheme for sewers and septic tanks

accepted.s: The zero sanitation deaths objective of NAMASTE is supported by which legislation, while NSKFDC was set up in which year?
accepted.x: NAMASTE is backed by the Manual Scavengers Act, 2013, and the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation was set up in 1997.
accepted.tq: Link the legislation and institutional founding year without swapping sectoral laws.
accepted.sec: Sanitation workers' welfare - NAMASTE scheme for sewers and septic tanks

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: TRIFED — 1987 — tribal marketing and MSP for Minor Forest Produce
Roshni — 2018 — residential schools for SC students
VDVKs — 2013 — skills and jobs in LWE districts
PM Janjatiya Vikas Mission — 1987 — sanitation mechanisation
accepted.x: TRIFED was established in 1987 and is associated with tribal marketing and MSP for Minor Forest Produce. The other options interchange the purposes or years of different programmes.
accepted.tq: Start from the distinctive year-purpose pair and eliminate cross-matched programmes.
accepted.sec: Skill and livelihood programmes for tribals - Roshni, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, TRIFED, MSP for MFP

accepted.s: The PM Janjatiya Vikas Mission, associated with 2021-22, is run by TRIFED and includes which set of activities?
o: Civil Services coaching, NETS testing and residential schooling
PPE distribution, sewer profiling and sanitation stipends
Land purchase, pension payments and free electricity
Buying MFP at MSP, value addition and GI tags
accepted.x: The PM Janjatiya Vikas Mission is run by TRIFED and focuses on buying Minor Forest Produce at MSP, value addition and GI tags.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its sector-specific activity cluster.
accepted.sec: Skill and livelihood programmes for tribals - Roshni, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, TRIFED, MSP for MFP

accepted.s:
With reference to Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, consider the following statements:
1. A typical Kendra is associated with about 15 self-help groups.
2. Each group may have up to 20 gatherers.
3. At least 60% of the members are required to be from Scheduled Tribes.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Van Dhan Vikas Kendras generally involve about 15 SHGs, with up to 20 gatherers per group, and at least 60% ST participation.
accepted.tq: Verify the three composition figures together rather than confusing group size with ST share.
accepted.sec: Skill and livelihood programmes for tribals - Roshni, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, TRIFED, MSP for MFP

accepted.s: Roshni is a programme for:
o: Free coaching for SC students in Central Universities
MSP procurement from all farmers in border districts
Mechanised cleaning of septic tanks in urban areas
Skills and jobs for tribal youth in Left-Wing Extremism districts
accepted.x: Roshni, associated with the Ministry of Rural Development and 2013, provides skills and employment opportunities for tribal youth in LWE districts.
accepted.tq: Use the target group, geography and purpose together to identify the programme.
accepted.sec: Skill and livelihood programmes for tribals - Roshni, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, TRIFED, MSP for MFP

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the latest figures for Van Dhan Vikas Kendras is correct?
accepted.x: The reported figures are 4,172 Van Dhan Vikas Kendras and 12.48 lakh members.
accepted.tq: Treat the Kendra count and membership count as a paired data set.
accepted.sec: Skill and livelihood programmes for tribals - Roshni, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, TRIFED, MSP for MFP

accepted.s: In Andhra Pradesh, how many Van Dhan Vikas Kendras were sanctioned and how many were working?
accepted.x: In Andhra Pradesh, 415 VDVKs were sanctioned and 258 were working.
accepted.tq: Watch for the reversed comparison between sanctioned and operational units.
accepted.sec: Skill and livelihood programmes for tribals - Roshni, Van Dhan Vikas Kendras, TRIFED, MSP for MFP

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about scholarships for SC and ST students:
1. The Post-Matric Scholarship for SCs is the largest central scheme for SC students.
2. Its cost is shared in the ratio of 60:40.
3. ST pre-matric and post-matric scholarships are centrally sponsored schemes.
4. National Fellowship, Top Class and National Overseas are central sector schemes.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The SC Post-Matric Scholarship is the largest central SC scheme with 60:40 cost sharing, while the specified ST scholarships are classified as stated.
accepted.tq: Classify each scholarship by beneficiary group and funding pattern before choosing the combination.
accepted.sec: Scholarships for SC/ST students - pre-matric, post-matric, National Overseas, Top Class, fellowships

accepted.s: The National Overseas Scholarship for ST students provides how many awards annually, with what distribution?
accepted.x: The National Overseas Scholarship provides 20 awards a year, comprising 17 for ST students and 3 for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
accepted.tq: Preserve the total and its internal category split as a single numerical relationship.
accepted.sec: Scholarships for SC/ST students - pre-matric, post-matric, National Overseas, Top Class, fellowships

accepted.s: The income limit specified for the National Overseas Scholarship for ST students is:
accepted.x: The income limit for the National Overseas Scholarship for ST students is Rs 6 lakh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the scholarship income ceiling from the separate NSFDC family-income limit.
accepted.sec: Scholarships for SC/ST students - pre-matric, post-matric, National Overseas, Top Class, fellowships

accepted.s: The pre-matric scholarship for ST students mentioned in the welfare framework covers which classes?
accepted.x: The ST pre-matric scholarship covers Classes IX and X; the post-matric scholarship applies thereafter.
accepted.tq: Use the exact class range to distinguish pre-matric from post-matric assistance.
accepted.sec: Scholarships for SC/ST students - pre-matric, post-matric, National Overseas, Top Class, fellowships
